creationBrief: I inspected both retained PI3K network SVG themes and current public owner/reference text. The old art supplies membrane lipid conversion, recruited AKT, two mTOR complexes and a fictional readout inset. I retain it unchanged and reuse that linked molecular map as the detail reference. Its actual geometry has no returning inhibitory feedback loop and no visibly separate inhibitor nodes. I choose a narrow concept-owner overview that locates membrane PIP2/PIP3 conversion and AKT below it, names distinct inhibited nodes, and draws an indirect feedback brake returning from mTORC1 output to upstream input. A separate fictional observation cannot prove this wiring, universal activity, dependence or clinical benefit. No shared-owner or old-native/support writes.
